references.text: Similar to the event in Mark 8:1 where Jesus feeds a large crowd, here Jesus feeds 5,000 men, besides women and children, with five loaves of bread and two fish.
Another event where Jesus feeds a large crowd, this time 4,000 men, besides women and children, with seven loaves of bread and a few small fish, which resembles the event in Mark 8:1.
Similar to the event in Mark 8:1, where Jesus feeds a crowd, here he feeds 5,000 men with five loaves of bread and two fish.
Similar to the event in Mark 8:1, where Jesus feeds a large crowd, here Jesus feeds 5,000 men with five barley loaves and two small fish.
